We're here to get you out. Standby for immediate pickup.|A crewmember|}} '''''Evac One''''' was an [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] originally known as '''Transport Ship 63378''' which was stolen from the [[Galactic Empire]] and later used as an [[evac ship]] by the [[Spectres]]. ==Description== {{Quote|That's not one of us!|TK-626, referring to Transport 63378 as it was being stollen by the Specters.|}} Evac One was an [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] for use in the [[Imperial Military|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. 63.8 [[meter]]s long, 32 meters wide and 14.7 meters high, the [[Starship|ship]] was armed with a dorsal twin [[laser cannon]] [[turret]] and a ventral heavy [[laser]] [[cannon]] turret. Like all Imperial ''Gozanti''-class ships, it could transport either four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s, four [[All Terrain Defense Pod]]s or even two [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}} on underside-mounted docking clamps.{{Rebels|Droids in Distress}} Its hull was painted a light [[Color|gray]], in keeping with the Empire's preference for muted colors.''[[Star Wars Rebels: A New Hero]]'' After it became a rebel ship under the name of ''Evac One'', its appearance remained mostly unchanged save for an orange [[Starbird (symbol)|starbird]] painted at the starboard side. ==History== {{Quote|The transport you stole will get us close to the fleet over Mustafar. We know they have Kanan on Tarkin's Star Destroyer.''"
"''And it's surrounded by a bunch of other Star Destroyers.''"
"''Uh, lots more. We'll need a distraction to cover our entry. Sabine?''"
"''Engine room's here, all the power for the ship. If we could get inside the docking bay, I could rig something, black 'em out. But our transport ship's not gonna fit in there.|Hera Syndulla, Garazeb Orrelios, and Sabine Wren|}} [[File:EvacOneApproachesSovereign.png|thumb|300px|left|The ship during the rescue of Kanan Jarrus]] The ship was known to the Empire as Transport Ship 63378. In [[4 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Fire Across the Galaxy]]" to [[4 BBY]]. it was stolen by the [[Spectres]] to [[Action at Mustafar|rescue]] their leader, [[Kanan Jarrus]], from the [[Mustafar system]]. [[Sabine Wren]] made a distraction at a [[Lothal]] [[hangar]] while her fellow rebels absconded with the cruiser. They then added their previously [[Attack on Imperial Troop Transports|stolen]] [[Rebels TIE fighter|TIE fighter]] in order to enter the [[Star system|system]]. They rendezvoused with the [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Sovereign]]'' for the rescue, leaving their droid [[C1-10P]] to [[pilot]] it. After rescuing Jarrus, they fled the Star Destroyer, but C1-10P had left with the [[transport]]. He then returned leading a [[Phoenix Cell|rebel fleet]], and together they escaped the system. It was later used by the larger rebellion, seeing action as an [[Evac ship|evacuation ship]] under the callsign ''Evac One'', such as the [[Skirmish on Imvur|skirmish]] on [[Imvur]]. {{Ship-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Transport Ship 63378 first appeared in "[[Fire Across the Galaxy]]," the finale of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. It was later confirmed to be the same ship as ''Evac One'' by the author [[Martin Fisher]].{{Twitter|tronprogram2|status/777717946416263168|[[Martin Fisher]]|quote=It was intended to be.|archivefile=File:Stolen Evac One.png}} ==Appearances== *''[[Battle to the End]]'' *{{Rebels|Fire Across the Galaxy}} {{1st}} *{{RebelsMagCite|17|Vulnerable Areas}} {{1stID|Evac One}} ==Sources== *{{RebelsRecon|uDZsNg-V39g|#1.12: Inside "Call to Action" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-call-to-action}} *{{RebelsRecon|xggYEpemcck|#1.14: Inside "Fire Across the Galaxy" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-fire-across-the-galaxy}} *{{SW|url=series/fire-across-the-galaxy-episode-guide|text="Fire Across the Galaxy" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{BuildFalconCite|23|Starship Fact File}} {{Po}} *{{BuildFalconCite|34|Starship Fact File}} *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Visual Guide: Epic Battles]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=エヴァック・ワン |pl=Transportowiec 63378 }} [[Category:Captured starships]] [[Category:Imperial-model Gozanti-class cruisers]] [[Category:Phoenix Squadron starships]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Empire]]
